case_number: 2024 INSC 77; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.523 OF 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.6562 OF 2021)

parties.respondent: State Of Bihar & Anr. (R1: State of Bihar; R2: Maharaj Kumar Man Vijay Singh)

summary: PoA-based land sale validity; appellant as bona fide vendee; FIR under IPC s.409,467,468,471,420 challenged; civil suit prior ruling confirmed PoA authority to sell; criminal prosecution abuse of process due to civil court validation of sale deed; territorial jurisdiction defect; no fraud against appellant established; High Court's dismissal of quashing petition set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Evidence Act, 1872 s.40, s.41, s.42, s.43
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Impugned judgment quashing FIR set aside; criminal proceedings against appellant quashed; territorial jurisdiction deficiency noted.
